support.title: TRACE is free and stays free
support.body: If TRACE saves you time at the bench, please support its further development with €5. Your support pays for the development tools and services behind TRACE, the Windows code-signing certificate, the Apple Developer Program needed to sign the macOS build, the website and new projects — the next one is coming soon and will later be integrated into TRACE.
